profile.headline: Principal Software Engineer
profile.summary:
Software engineer with 15 years across industrial IoT data engineering, enterprise RPA, full-stack .NET, and backend Go microservices. Now Principal Software Engineer at a financial technology company, working on event-driven service architecture, production reliability, and the AI tooling layer my team builds on.

I've delivered across the full stack — SQL Server schema design and query optimization on industrial IoT datasets, ETL pipelines, RPA automation in Blue Prism, UiPath and Automation Anywhere, and today NATS JetStream event pipelines with REST and GraphQL services on Kubernetes serving customer-facing applications. Most recently I led an event-driven pipeline across three Go microservices: a real-time webhook consumer processing external financial events, a REST service exposing persisted state, and a GraphQL layer aggregating several backends into one customer-facing API.

Much of my current value sits before and after the code. Before: auditing multi-service designs against the actual repositories and production data — 15+ work items and 8 specifications in one release — and correcting diverged requirements before three teams start building on them. After: root-cause investigation on the problems nobody has explained yet. Evidence-first diagnosis across logs, metrics, live databases, container inspection and commit history — finding a race condition between two services, a state-wipe regression on a status transition, and a concurrency hazard that affected seven handlers, not the two reported. I hold my own conclusions to that standard too, and have retracted and re-derived my own incident numbers.

That same discipline carries into application security, where I've identified unauthenticated data-exposure paths on internal KYC/AML tooling — including a rendering gap that had survived an earlier remediation for two years — and turned each into a scoped, phased remediation plan rather than a ticket.

I design and operationalize AI-integrated engineering workflows: MCP connectors that give agents governed access to logs, observability, data stores and source control; reusable agent skills that encode verified team procedures instead of generic prompts; and multi-round validation protocols that catch implementation errors before production. The aim is institutional knowledge that outlives any one person's memory — onboarding guides, decision logs and runbooks that let distributed teams move fast in the right direction.

Go · C#/.NET · Node/NestJS · TypeScript · GraphQL · NATS · MongoDB · PostgreSQL · SQL Server · DynamoDB · AWS · Kubernetes

positions.title: Principal Software Engineer
positions.description:
Principal Software Engineer at TradeStation, designing and delivering backend microservices and data pipelines for financial technology products.
Led the end-to-end implementation of an event-driven data pipeline across three interconnected Go microservices — a real-time webhook consumer processing external financial events via NATS JetStream, a REST API service exposing MongoDB-persisted state to downstream consumers, and a GraphQL resolver layer aggregating multiple backend services into a unified data API for a customer-facing application. Resolved complex messaging infrastructure challenges including WorkQueue exclusive-consumer conflicts through NATS stream sourcing and explicit stream binding to bypass auto-discovery routing failures in Kubernetes staging.
Drove architecture governance across a multi-service release — auditing 15+ work items and 8 technical specifications, correcting diverged requirements, and realigning documentation to confirmed designs before development began across three teams.
Designed and operationalized an AI-integrated engineering workflow combining structured prompt engineering, multi-round validation protocols, and CLI-based code generation — catching critical implementation errors before production and accelerating team adoption of AI tooling.
Delivered across Go, Node.js/NestJS, C#/.NET Core, GraphQL, MongoDB, PostgreSQL, DynamoDB, AWS, and Kubernetes. Focused on backward-compatible schema design, graceful degradation patterns, and end-to-end staging validation using pod inspection, event stream monitoring, and centralized log correlation.

positions.title: Senior Consultant and Developer
positions.description:
Senior Consultant and Software Engineer at EY, delivering end-to-end data engineering solutions and intelligent automation for industrial manufacturing and enterprise clients.
Architected and implemented a complete IoT-to-dashboard data pipeline — ingesting real-time sensor and production data from IoT devices and OPC Servers, processing and transforming it through ETL pipelines built in C#/.NET Core, persisting intermediate data in MongoDB, and loading structured analytical data into Azure SQL Server for executive reporting. The resulting dashboards gave company CEOs visibility into production line performance, material consumption per production line, and predictive maintenance windows — enabling data-driven decisions that prevented unplanned production line shutdowns.
Owned the full data engineering stack across this pipeline: designed and optimized Azure SQL Server schemas, authored complex T-SQL including recursive CTEs and advanced stored procedures, built user-defined functions and non-clustered indexes, and performed deep execution plan analysis to tune query performance on high-volume industrial datasets. Designed and executed SSIS/Integration Services packages for data migration and transformation across heterogeneous platforms.
Developed RESTful API services in TypeScript and C#/.NET Core with asynchronous request handling, and built ETL workflows for large-scale financial and operational data transformation. Designed, developed, and deployed Robotic Process Automation solutions across Blue Prism, UiPath, and Automation Anywhere — automating intercommunication between enterprise systems through XML and collection serialization.
Stack: C#/.NET Core, TypeScript, SQL Server, Azure, MongoDB, SSIS, OPC Server, Blue Prism, UiPath, Automation Anywhere, Postman, Visual Studio, GitHub.

positions.description:
Senior Software Engineer focused on backend systems development, database engineering, and API integration across enterprise platforms.
Designed and delivered backend systems in C#/.NET including MVC web applications and ASP.NET Web API services consumed by mobile clients, handling complex business logic with an N-layer architecture, LINQ/PLINQ, lambda expressions, and XML/JSON serialization for cross-system data exchange.
Developed and optimized SQL Server database components including stored procedures, user-defined functions, non-clustered indexes, and user types. Conducted deep execution plan analysis to diagnose and resolve performance bottlenecks on high-volume datasets. Built communication interface layers in C# for structured data exchange between disparate enterprise systems using XML frame serialization.
Delivered full testing cycles across all projects: unit testing, integration testing, regression testing, and end-to-end process flow validation. Participated in requirements analysis and contributed to technical design from specification through delivery.
